claims.statement: DEP02-B heater was 399.77 at 67.5 hours then jumped to 411.13 at 69.0 hours and 411.51 at 72.0 hours
After the jump LOT-1232 measured 512.56 on MET01 while before the jump LOT-1224 measured 500.66
Alarm lot LOT-1239 measured on MET02 is 510.99 with in_control false, confirming thick film on the other metrology tool
DEP02-B mean is 502.32 with max 512.56 while DEP01-A mean is 497.54 and DEP01-B mean is 499.37 and DEP02-A mean is 499.55

disposition.summary: Heater on DEP02-B stepped up around 69 hours and two wafers after it are thick and out of control. Different clean tools and different metrology tools both show the shift, so it is a real chamber heater change. Hold the alarm lot and the chamber.
